annotations.title: Household electricity and gas prices over time

description: Development of household electricity and gas prices per kWh (Czechia), as published by Eurostat (semi-annual, all taxes and levies included, the most common consumption band), with the dataset link and the day it was fetched; never interpolated. Our own price-list readings start on own_history_since and are not yet a series. Use energy_unit_prices for today's price from the current price lists.
